purpose: Find something fast by typing or by browsing suggestions.
layout: A focused search field at the very top, then recent searches as removable chips, then suggested categories or trending items. Results, when shown, are dense rows.

required: Search field (focused look, with clear button)
optional: Voice or scan icon in the field

primaryAction.note: Typing and tapping a suggestion are the actions.

avoid: A hero or marketing banner above the field
